Name: Shared Fishing
Author: Galo223344
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Shows an overlay next to anyone fishing that mirrors how they are doing in the fishing mini-game.[/color][/size]

Was only tested with up-to two players but it should work fine with more, you can modify config.json (or use the mod config menu) to change the scale and update rate of the overlay.

Manifest.Name: Shared Fishing
Manifest.Description: See other players' fishing minigame bar as a small overlay in multiplayer - watch the green bar and fish move in real time!
Manifest.Author: Galo223344
